long_biography.plain_text:
Leonardo Ferragamo entered his family's fashion company at 20, beginning in leather production. He founded the men's shoes business and later broadened it into a division spanning footwear, accessories and clothing. From there he took charge of international development, establishing operating subsidiaries across Asia, Europe and Latin America.

His responsibilities now combine inheritance with active stewardship. Ferragamo serves as executive chairman of Salvatore Ferragamo and remains involved in the family holding structure. He also leads Lungarno Collection and chairs Nautor Swan. He acquired sole control of the Finnish builder in 1998, guided its product and racing development, and remained chairman after Sanlorenzo took a majority stake in 2024.
